messages:
Maya: Creating RC for inference-runtime — v2.3.0-rc4. Candidate SHA: abcdef1234. Target promo tonight 00:00 UTC. Quick summary: KV cache tuning, prefer-lazy-kv flag, small batching perf tweak. Requesting signoff from eng + infra + oncall. Rollback plan: pin back to v2.3.0-rc3 + traffic shim. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.0-rc4

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: inference-runtime:v2.3.0-rc4 (id: ar-20260320-88). Automated checks: unit/integration passed, smoke started in staging. To promote run:
```
deploy promote --service inference-runtime --artifact ar-20260320-88 --to prod --strategy staged --steps 5,25,60
```

Alex: FYI last canary we saw intermittent 95th latency spikes during kv-warm. Which config changed here?

Sam: I observed two transient OOMs during the headroom test earlier on g4-2 pools (03:18 UTC). Root cause looked like large batch windows + greedy prefetch. I re-ran the headroom job with reduced max_batch and didn't repro. Recommend disabling auto-batching for initial 5% stage.

Priya: Oncall here. Conditional +1 if rollout starts at 5% with a 15m smoke, deadman alarms enabled (error rate > 1.5% OR p95 > 2s for 2 intervals), and a pinned fallback model (v2.2.9-quant) ready to route to. I'll own monitoring.

Maya: Acknowledged. Updated rollout plan in the ops doc: start 5% (15m) -> 25% (15m) -> 60% (30m) -> 100%. Deadman = error_rate > 1.5% OR p95(latency) > 2s for two consecutive intervals -> auto-rollback to v2.3.0-rc3 and enable traffic shim. I've added the fallback model pin command to the runbook.

Alex: I'll sign off provided we turn off auto-batching for first stage and add the traffic shim at 5%. Can you patch the config?

Maya: Done. Pushed config toggle: `auto_batching: false` for rolloutStages[0]. Added traffic shim value = 5%. Pinned artifact in deployment manifest. Ops runbook link: https://redwood.internal/ops/runbooks/inference-rc

Sam: I added an alert to ops channel and a deploy-bot rollback hook. If deadman triggers, deploy-bot will pin rc3 and run `traffic shift --service inference-runtime --to rc3 --percent 100 --fast` automatically.

deploy-bot: canary metrics snapshot (30m): p50=120ms, p95=650ms, errors=0.12%. KV-warm warnings: observed 3 warnings in logs but no new OOMs after config change.

Priya: +signoff (oncall). I'll be watching dashboards and traces during the smoke.

Alex: +eng signoff. I'll be on-call for infra during the promo window. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks. I'll kick the promote at 00:00 UTC and post updates here.

Maya: `deploy promote --service inference-runtime --artifact ar-20260320-88 --to prod --strategy staged --steps 5,25,60`

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Step 1: 5% -> done. Metrics (5m) p50=118ms p95=620ms errors=0.09%. No deadman conditions met.

Alex: watching :eyes:

Maya: Step 2 -> 25% in 2m. Will report after the 15m pause.

deploy-bot: Step 2: 25% -> metrics stable. Continuing to 60% per schedule unless anyone flags something.

Sam: noticed one replica with elevated mem usage ~80% but below OOM. Keeping thumbs.

Priya: continuing watch. If p95 > 2s or errors > 1.5% for two intervals, I'll trigger rollback.

Maya: thanks all — final notes appended to release doc and pinned artifact. If rollback happens, I'll open a followup thread with postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
